login.title: Sign in to Easy Voice
login.tagline: Your AI agent, with its own phone number.
login.googleEmail: Your Google account email isn't verified.

email.otpBody: Your sign-in code is {code}. It expires in 10 minutes.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.stepAgent: Create an agent (pick or clone a voice)
dashboard.stepConnect: Connect the agent to your number
dashboard.stepCall: Make or receive your first call

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: An agent answers and places calls with the voice and instructions you give it.
agents.empty: No agents yet. <link>Create your first agent</link>.
agents.keyRejected: Can't take or make calls: ElevenLabs rejected your API key.
agents.keyRejectedNotice: This agent can't take or make calls: ElevenLabs rejected your API key, so its voice can't speak. <link>Replace the key</link> or pick another voice.
agents.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its number will stop answering calls.
agents.languageHint: Callers can still mix English and Mandarin.
agents.voiceHint: Mandarin agents need a Mandarin + English voice. English-only voices always reply in English.
agents.modelsHint: The language model decides what the agent says. Calls cost the same with any model.
agents.greetingHint: The first thing the agent says when answering. A recording notice ("{noticeEn}" / "{noticeZh}") is added automatically. On calls the agent places, it opens with "{outboundEn}" / "{outboundZh}" instead.
agents.instructionsHint: How the agent should behave on calls. Use '{{'call_direction'}}' (inbound or outbound) and '{{'call_goal'}}' (what you ask for when placing a call).

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.intro: Reference material this agent can look up during calls: notes, files or a website. Each source costs {price}, charged once.
knowledge.privacy: Callers may hear anything you add here. Don't add anything you wouldn't want read out on a call.
knowledge.modeReference: Reference: prefer it, and answer other questions from general knowledge
knowledge.modeStrict: Strict: answer factual questions only from it, the instructions and the call goal
knowledge.usage: {count} of {max} sources used across your agents.
knowledge.noUsable: This agent has no usable sources yet, so it can't look anything up.
knowledge.notApplied: The knowledge base isn't applied to this agent yet. It's retried automatically.
knowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete this source? It's removed permanently and isn't refunded.
knowledge.fileHint: TXT or MD up to {chars, number} characters, or a PDF under {size, number} MB. Scanned PDFs can't be read.
knowledge.urlHint: The page and pages it links to on the same site are read. Sites with more than {pages} pages fail and aren't refunded. One website per agent.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: The voices your agents can use, and where you make new ones.
voices.noClones: No cloned voices yet. Make one in the Voice Lab below.
voices.deleteConfirmElevenLabs: Delete voice "{name}"? It's also deleted from your ElevenLabs account.
voices.labIntro: Record or upload someone speaking, and get a voice that sounds like them.
voices.connectToClone: Connect a voice service to start cloning.
voices.cloneLimit: You can have up to {max} cloned voices per service. Delete one to clone another.
voices.useOwnElevenLabs: You can still clone with your own ElevenLabs account: use “Add a service” below.
voices.elevenLabsOption: Your account. Free here; calls use your ElevenLabs credits.
voices.sampleHint: Clear speech, one speaker, no background noise: 10–15 seconds. Max {max}.
voices.sampleHintElevenLabs: Clear speech, one speaker, no background noise: 10–15 seconds (ElevenLabs works best with 1–2 minutes). Max {max}.
voices.consent: This is my own voice, or I have the speaker's explicit permission to clone it.
voices.cloned: Voice cloned. You can use it in an agent now.
voices.cloneStarted: Cloning started. It's usually ready within a minute.
voices.sampleTooLarge: That sample is {size}. The limit is {max} — use a shorter clip.

numbers.title: Phone numbers
numbers.description: US local numbers, {price}/month, charged from your balance.
numbers.empty: You don't have a number yet. Search for one below.
numbers.receivesTexts: Receives texts ({price}/segment) in <link>Messages</link>. Replies aren't supported.
numbers.smsSettingUp: Texting is being set up for this number.
numbers.activating: Activating with the carrier… refresh in a moment.
numbers.releaseConfirm: Release {number}? You will lose this number permanently.
numbers.nearbyOnly: No numbers left in {area}; these are from nearby area codes.
numbers.noResults: No numbers available for that area code. Try another.
numbers.simulatedCall: Simulated call placed — check Calls in a few seconds.

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: Calls are billed at {price}/min, rounded up.
calls.needBoth: You need <number>an active number</number> and <agent>a ready agent</agent> to place calls.
calls.needNumber: You need <number>an active number</number> to place calls.
calls.needAgent: You need <agent>a ready agent</agent> to place calls.
calls.goal: What should the agent do on this call? (optional)
calls.goalHint: Passed to the agent as '{{'call_goal'}}' for this call only. Its instructions decide how to use it.
calls.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Call Dr. Lee's office and move my Thursday 3pm appointment to next week.
calls.callerId: Calls show your number {number} as caller ID. Only call people who expect to hear from your assistant.
calls.inProgress: Call in progress — your agent is talking.
calls.deleteConfirm: Delete this call's recording, transcript and summary? Billing records are kept.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Texts sent to your number, {price} per segment. Receive only: replies aren't supported.
messages.smsOff: Receiving texts isn't turned on for this service yet.
messages.getNumber: <link>Get a number</link> to start receiving texts.
messages.smsSettingUp: Texting is still being set up for {number}. Check back later.
messages.attachments: {count, plural, one {# attachment} other {# attachments}} (not shown)
messages.deleteConfirm: Delete all texts from {name}? This can't be undone.
messages.footer: You can't reply from Easy Voice. Texts are deleted after {days} days.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your balance and payments, and the services you've connected.

apiKeys.intro: Connect your own accounts with other services. Voices you clone with them can be used by your agents.
apiKeys.rejectedNotice: ElevenLabs rejected this key on {date}: it may have been revoked, expired or lost a permission. Calls with your ElevenLabs voices are declined until you replace it below with a working key for the same account.
apiKeys.keyEnding: Key ending <mono>{hint}</mono>. Voices you clone with ElevenLabs live in your ElevenLabs account, and calls with them use your ElevenLabs credits.
apiKeys.replaceHint: A new key for the same ElevenLabs account.
apiKeys.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect ElevenLabs? Voices cloned with it are removed here; they stay in your ElevenLabs account.
apiKeys.connectIntro: Clone voices in your own ElevenLabs account, free here, and use them in your agents. Calls with those voices use your ElevenLabs credits. Cloning needs the Starter plan or higher.
apiKeys.keyHint: In ElevenLabs, open Developers → API keys and create a key with access to Text to Speech, Voices (write) and User (read).
apiKeys.connected: ElevenLabs connected. You can now clone voices with it on the Voices page.

billing.intro: Prepaid credit. Usage is deducted from your balance.
billing.paymentReceived: Payment received. Your balance will update in a moment if it hasn't already.
billing.checkoutCancelled: Checkout was cancelled. You weren't charged.
billing.balanceEmpty: Your balance is empty. Incoming calls are declined and outgoing calls are blocked until you top up.
billing.releaseWarning: Numbers are released after {days} days with a negative balance.
billing.devOnly: Dev only — add credit without paying (hidden in production)
billing.terms: Payments are processed by Stripe. There are no subscriptions — number rental is deducted from your balance every 30 days. Call minutes are rounded up. Unanswered calls are free. Failed purchases are refunded automatically, except a website that turns out too large to use. Deleted knowledge sources aren't refunded.
billing.segmentNote: A text segment holds up to 160 characters, or 70 when it contains Chinese characters or emoji.
